commander_specific_reason: Draw engine triggers on other nontoken artifact creature/Vehicle entries; can be casualty-copied and provides ongoing card flow. Higher mana value is supported by cost reducers.
Protects all other artifact creatures with hexproof. Ashad can copy it, and two copies protect each other; improves resilience of the artifact-creature engine.
Copied ETB mills three and returns artifact creature cards with total mana value six or less; two resolutions can rebuild a board. High cost but artifact cost reducers help.
Repeatable artifact-copy trigger is more valuable than one-shot Dalek/token utility. No self-loop: the Ultron Drone copy is a token and does not satisfy nontoken-entry condition.

Strong repeated artifact-copy engine, but five-mana nonartifact legendary creature and overlaps Brudiclad, Auton Soldier, Ultron, Sculpting Steel and Phyrexian Metamorph. Selected artifact creatures directly use Ashad casualty.

High-ceiling Cyberman/death payoff but six mana and its death-return trigger only sees nonartifact creatures, while much of the fodder is artifact creatures; existing sacrifice/death payoffs are dense.
Creates a fixed number of Necron tokens and has unearth, but Spyder adds repeatable draw and Technomancer provides stronger graveyard recursion.
Large Vehicle but needs crew and combat damage for its library/token payoff; no immediate ETB and less reliable than Spyder/Technomancer.
Strong attack-triggered artifact recursion, but it is legendary and does not receive Ashad's casualty 2; its payoff is combat-dependent.
Cost reduction is useful but overlaps Artificer Class, Enthusiastic Mechanaut, Etherium Sculptor, Foundry Inspector and Tezzeret.
Large artifact body and anthem overlap Cyberdrive Awakener, Tezzeret and token-copy engines; no stronger than the selected recursion/protection additions.
Recurring combat token can be fodder but is not an artifact token and overlaps Cybermen Squadron, Poetic Ingenuity, Simulacrum Synthesizer, Ultron and Worldwalker Helm.
Colorless land would add pressure to a 30-land three-color mana base; Academy Ruins and Inventors' Fair already provide artifact recursion/tutoring.
Potential artifact-spell mana utility but colorless land pressure is undesirable in a 30-land UBR list; no clearly superior cut for it.
Technomancer's copied ETBs can mill and reanimate multiple artifact creatures within a six-mana-value cap; Warden's token count is fixed and less impactful in this artifact graveyard shell.

A token copy of Spyder does not trigger the original's 'nontoken' entry condition, but the token Spyder sees the original nontoken Spyder enter; both can trigger for future nontoken artifact creatures.
Other artifact creatures you control have hexproof. Two Cryptothralls grant each other hexproof and protect the rest of the artifact-creature board; hexproof does not stop untargeted wipes.
Each ETB mills three and returns artifact creature cards with total mana value six or less. Copy and original resolve separately; cards returned by the first cannot be returned by the second.
Its trigger requires another nontoken artifact entering; Ultron Drone token copies do not create a self-trigger loop.
Copy multiplier only affects instant/sorcery spells, a secondary package in an artifact-spell casualty deck; Cryptothrall protects key artifact creatures.
Three-mana rock and one-turn creature copy are useful, but ramp count remains high and Spyder adds repeatable artifact-creature draw.
Slow incremental Thopter/draw engine overlaps other token engines; Technomancer adds a powerful copied artifact-recursion line.
Ultron offers repeatable artifact-copy value rather than a smaller one-shot token/tribal effect.
Candidate rank and commander synergy support retaining its artifact/vehicle value; no better slot-level replacement was found.
Retained as an artifact token/value engine; complements Ultron, Poetic Ingenuity and Simulacrum Synthesizer rather than being redundant in every role.
Nine-mana artifact can be copied by Ashad and offers high-impact removal/reanimation; artifact cost reduction and ramp justify the slot.
Nonlegendary artifact creature spell can be copied and each ETB destroys a creature and gains life; efficient high-impact casualty target.
Six-mana artifact creature is a strong copied body with lifelink/deathtouch and death tokens; not displaced by Spyder/Technomancer.
Flash for artifact spells enables casualty on opponents' turns, making Ashad's 'each turn' wording materially exploitable.
Staff can be copied by Ashad but its payoff is limited to instant/sorcery copies; Cryptothrall better protects the primary artifact-creature plan.
Mirror's ramp and one-turn creature copy are good; Spyder is a durable draw engine for the deck's many nontoken artifact creature entries.
Network is a slow token/draw engine and overlaps existing engines; Technomancer can return multiple artifact creatures via two copied ETBs, with cost reducers helping its high mana value.
